title: Pablo Red Nicotine Pouches - 24mg / Pouch
description: Pablo Red Nicotine Pouches bring a fiery burst of flavour and a serious nicotine hit in a slim, discreet format. Each pouch delivers a strong 24mg dose of nicotine, making this a high-intensity option for experienced users. While the exact flavour profile is a closely guarded secret, Pablo Red is often described as having a punchy, almost spicy character with a clean, lingering finish. Tobacco-free and easy to use, each pouch sits comfortably under the lip, releasing nicotine quickly without smoke, vapour or odour. Perfect for on-the-go use or moments when discretion is key, Pablo Red is a bold choice for those who like their nicotine strong and their flavours intense. How to Use: 1 Place a pouch between your upper lip and gum for a consistent nicotine release for up to 60min 2 Place the used pouch in the designated top compartment of the pack. 3 Dispose of the pouch. PLEASE DO NOT CHEW OR SWALLOW POUCH Please Note: These nicotine pouches are 24mg of nicotine per pouch and 30mg nicotine per gram.
